verdict.rationale: CSC documents a centralized dashboard of entity information across all jurisdictions (csc-docs-2). Its CSCNavigator good-standing Compliance Calendar is updated in real time and auto-creates annual-report filing events (csc-docs-10, csc-docs-11). Reports list upcoming filings 45 days ahead with each entity's good standing status, and Corporate Tracker alerts on standing changes (csc-docs-8, csc-docs-12). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that state/foreign registrations (not just entities) appear in the same view, confirmation that standing and deadlines sit together on one dashboard rather than across calendar, reports and alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
